resources.string: Drop an APK anywhere, browse, or enter its path. Configure everything before patching.
The original APK is kept. Existing output files require confirmation before replacement.
Leave blank to save beside the input APK.

{filename} — input name without extension
{ext} — input extension
{filenameext} — complete input name
{package} — application package
{label} — application label
{code} — application version code
{version} — application version name
{overport} — patching library version

Example: {package}-{version}.patched.apk
Blank uses {filename}.output.{ext}. Metadata tags resolve when the APK is patched.
Base libraries come from upstream OVRPort. Our fork's native compatibility fixes are bundled with this application.
Use latest, experimental, or an exact version. Latest includes compatible experimental releases. Missing libraries are downloaded when patching.
Ready when you are. Select an APK to patch.
The filename template must produce a filename, not a directory path.
Output would overwrite the original APK. Choose a different filename or directory.
Input and output must be outside the workspace's internal dec directory.
%1$s\n\nThis output file already exists. Replace it with the newly patched APK?
An operation is running. Wait for it to finish before closing the application.
